home.headline: Advancing biomembranes and nanomedicine for human health
home.subhead: We study membrane processes at the interface of cells, pathogens, and molecular tools — from viral and vector-borne disease to cardiovascular risk and cancer.
home.featuredLead: Infection, cardiovascular risk and cancer — three clinical challenges we approach through membrane biophysics, peptides and atomic force microscopy.
home.ctaBandLead: Discover active projects, focus themes, and collaborations across biomembranes and nanomedicine.
home.axesLead: From enveloped-virus membrane mechanisms and cardiovascular risk to antimicrobial peptides, AFM, and vector surveillance.
home.hubsLead: An ACL-2 insectary, a field ovitrap network and OneVec — three platforms of the infectious-disease programme, each with its own site.
home.teamLead: Researchers, students and staff across biomembranes, nanomedicine and vector biology at GIMM.
home.outreachQuote: Mosquitoes, antivirals, and games — the lab in the middle of the science party.
home.outreachBody: We were at Jardins do Marquês in Oeiras: Aedes under the microscope, parasite games, and the AVITHRAPID project. More photos and behind-the-scenes on Instagram.
home.outreachAlt: Nuno Santos Lab team at European Researchers’ Night 2026, Oeiras

research.title: Biomembranes & nanomedicine
research.lead: Membrane biophysics at the interface of infection, cardiovascular risk and cancer — including Aedes, Wolbachia and vector surveillance.
research.axesLead: Three disease pillars. Vector biology — Aedes, Wolbachia, surveillance — sits under infectious diseases.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: This site is a laboratory brochure. It does not use analytics cookies, does not create accounts, and does not run a contact form.
privacy.whatBody: Pages are static. Optional theme preference is stored in your browser (localStorage). Outbound links go to GIMM, FMUL, ORCID, and the lab’s platforms (insectary, ovitrap network, OneVec).
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions about this brochure, email the group leader. OneVec, the insectary and the ovitrap network have their own privacy notices.
